messages:
maya: Heads-up 1 we need a compact inspector for auto-fallback decisions. Show mode, trigger, quota impact, and let SREs preview sampled requests without flipping routing. cc @liam @sarah
liam: Idea: one-line status chip on rollout card: mode icon + reason short + small quota delta. clicking opens right-hand inspector drawer with samples + top signals.
sarah: Add a sample-only toggle (dry-run) so we can measure impact 24-72h. inspector should show estimate: tokens/month and percent delta.
dan: API: status endpoint must return enums. add header `X-Redwood-Fallback: mode=soft;reason=latency;id=0x1c3f` so services can join traces. Support `?dry_run=true` on rollout endpoints.
aj: Header grammar: semicolon-separated lowercase k=v pairs, max 128 bytes. We'll publish an OpenAPI snippet.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy `autofallback-inspector` started by @liam  ci: https://ci.redwood/run/4991
maya: UX checklist: chip + hover tooltip, inspector drawer w/ sampled requests, top-3 signals, cooldown pill if oscillating, approver UI for protected rollouts.
liam: Cooldown pill should show a short timeline of last decisions and a pause button. policy engine exposes cooldown_remaining in status.
sarah: 'Why did we fallback?' modal needs top signals (p99, error%, quota) + copyable example header for downstream teams.
dan: I'll implement `decision_id` in telemetry and ensure sampled=true for previews. also `dry_run` returns decision headers but doesn't commit changes.
aj: Telemetry docs update: add `fallback_reason` enum and `decision_id` to v1 events; keep events flat for ingestion.
maya: Example chip copy: `[Soft  latency]  Quota est -3.9% monthly  Audit`
sarah: Also add a link to Optimize remediation from the inspector (batching/quant suggestions).
liam: Permissions: protected rollouts require rollout-owner + ops signoff. show approvers and block commit until approvals exist.
ops-bot: incident-bot: note: sampling spike on route `checkout` 2025-02-20T14:22Z  currently in sample-only mode.
dan: I'll correlate `decision_id=0x1c3f` with logs and sampled payloads.
aj: Small note: header timestamps should be epoch for compactness, but docs use ISO elsewhere.
maya: Action items: liam -> UI PR for chip + inspector; dan -> dry_run + decision_id; aj -> docs + OpenAPI; sarah -> inspector mock; maya -> copy + signoff. Sync tomorrow 10:00 to review canary metrics.
